content.json:
# Azure Arc demo: Estate overview
*Which servers are in the Arc estate, are they connected and sending telemetry, how busy are they, what changed, and what needs attention? Read-only: nothing on this page changes a machine, a rule or a setting.*

*Deeper evidence for the same machines: the Capacity and headroom and Optimisation opportunities workbooks.*

parameters.name: EnvironmentFilter
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines' | extend v = tostring(tags.env) | extend v = iff(isempty(v), '(untagged)', v) | summarize by v | project value = v, label = v | order by value asc

parameters.name: RoleFilter
parameters.label: Role
parameters.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines' | extend v = tostring(tags.role) | extend v = iff(isempty(v), '(untagged)', v) | summarize by v | project value = v, label = v | order by value asc

content.json:
## The estate at a glance
Machines in the Arc inventory against machines that are sending telemetry. A machine with no monitoring agent appears in Arc but not under *Reporting now*: present, not silent. Tiles answer for the filters above; alerts cover every alert rule in the subscription.

content.query:
let OsF = dynamic([{OsFilter}]);
let EnvF = dynamic([{EnvironmentFilter}]);
let RoleF = dynamic([{RoleFilter}]);
let OsAll = array_length(OsF) == 0 or set_has_element(OsF, 'value::all') or set_has_element(OsF, '*');
let EnvAll = array_length(EnvF) == 0 or set_has_element(EnvF, 'value::all') or set_has_element(EnvF, '*');
let RoleAll = array_length(RoleF) == 0 or set_has_element(RoleF, 'value::all') or set_has_element(RoleF, '*');
let Start = todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}');
let End = todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}');
let Step = case(End - Start <= 6h, 5m, End - Start <= 2d, 15m, End - Start <= 8d, 1h, End - Start <= 16d, 2h, 6h);
let ArcInv = arg("").Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| project Machine = tolower(name), ArcName = name, ArcOs = iff(tostring(properties.osType) =~ 'windows', 'Windows', 'Linux'), ArcStatus = tostring(properties.status),
    Tier = tostring(tags.osTier), Role = tostring(tags.role), Env = tostring(tags.env), MonitorTier = tostring(tags.monitorTier), Owner = tostring(tags.owner), CostCentre = tostring(tags.costcenter);
let Beat = Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize LastBeat = max(TimeGenerated), BeatOs = take_any(OSType) by Machine = tolower(Computer);
let PatchRows = arg("").patchassessmentresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchassessmentresults'
| project Machine = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/')[8])), AssessmentStatus = tostring(properties.status), Critical = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.critical),
    Security = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.security), UpdateRollup = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.updateRollup),
    Definition = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.definition), LastAssessed = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime);
let AllMachines = union ArcInv, Beat, PatchRows
| summarize ArcName = take_any(ArcName), ArcOs = take_any(ArcOs), ArcStatus = take_any(ArcStatus), Tier = take_any(Tier), Role = take_any(Role), Env = take_any(Env),
    MonitorTier = take_any(MonitorTier), Owner = take_any(Owner), CostCentre = take_any(CostCentre), LastBeat = max(LastBeat), BeatOs = take_any(BeatOs),
    AssessmentStatus = take_any(AssessmentStatus), Critical = take_any(Critical), Security = take_any(Security), UpdateRollup = take_any(UpdateRollup),
    Definition = take_any(Definition), LastAssessed = max(LastAssessed) by Machine
| extend InArc = isnotempty(ArcStatus), Name = iff(isnotempty(ArcName), ArcName, Machine),
    Os = iff(isnotempty(ArcOs), ArcOs, iff(BeatOs =~ 'windows', 'Windows', 'Linux')),
    Env = iff(isempty(Env), '(untagged)', Env), Role = iff(isempty(Role), '(untagged)', Role)
| extend PatchState = case(
    not(InArc), 'Not applicable',
    isempty(AssessmentStatus), 'Not assessed',
    AssessmentStatus =~ 'Succeeded' and Critical > 0, 'Critical updates pending',
    AssessmentStatus =~ 'Succeeded' and Security > 0, 'Security updates pending',
    AssessmentStatus =~ 'Succeeded', 'Fully patched',
    AssessmentStatus =~ 'InProgress', 'Assessment in progress',
    'Assessment failed');
let Machines = AllMachines
| where (OsAll or Os in (OsF)) and (EnvAll or Env in (EnvF)) and (RoleAll or Role in (RoleF));
let MachineList = toscalar(Machines | summarize make_set(Machine));
let SqlRows = arg("").Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| project Machine = tolower(tostring(split(tostring(properties.containerResourceId), '/')[8])), SqlName = name, SqlVersion = tostring(properties.version);
let AlertRows = arg("").alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| project Fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime), Severity = tostring(properties.essentials.severity)
| where Fired >= todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}') and Fired <= todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}');
let SqlStats = toscalar(Machines | lookup kind=inner (SqlRows) on Machine | summarize pack('n', count(), 'names', strcat_array(make_list(SqlName, 3), ', ')));
let AlertStats = toscalar(AlertRows | summarize pack('n', count(), 'lastfired', max(Fired), 'top', min(Severity)));
let Counts = Machines
| extend Reporting = isnotnull(LastBeat) and LastBeat > ago(15m), Silent = isnotnull(LastBeat) and LastBeat <= ago(15m), NoBeat = isnull(LastBeat)
| extend NoAgent = NoBeat and InArc and isempty(MonitorTier)
| summarize Total = count(), InArcN = countif(InArc), Connected = countif(InArc and ArcStatus =~ 'Connected'),
    Windows = countif(Os == 'Windows'), Linux = countif(Os == 'Linux'),
    WinTiers = strcat_array(make_set_if(Tier, Os == 'Windows' and isnotempty(Tier), 4), ' · '), LinTiers = strcat_array(make_set_if(Tier, Os == 'Linux' and isnotempty(Tier), 4), ' · '),
    Reporting = countif(Reporting), Silent = countif(Silent), NoAgent = countif(NoAgent), NoData = countif(NoBeat and not(NoAgent)),
    Tagged = countif(InArc and isnotempty(Owner) and isnotempty(CostCentre)),
    Pending = countif(PatchState in ('Critical updates pending', 'Security updates pending')),
    PatchGap = countif(PatchState in ('Not assessed', 'Assessment failed', 'Assessment in progress')),
    Patched = countif(PatchState == 'Fully patched');
Counts
| extend SqlN = tolong(SqlStats.n), SqlNames = tostring(SqlStats.names), AlertN = tolong(AlertStats.n), AlertLatest = todatetime(AlertStats.lastfired), AlertTop = tostring(AlertStats.top)
| extend AlertAgeMin = datetime_diff('minute', now(), AlertLatest)
| extend ReportNote = case(
    Total == 0, 'no machine matches the filters',
    Reporting == Total, strcat('all ', Total, ' sent a heartbeat in 15 min'),
    Reporting == 0 and Silent > 0, 'none in 15 min: parked or silent',
    Reporting == 0, 'no machine has sent telemetry',
    strcat('of ', Total, iff(NoAgent > 0, strcat(' · ', NoAgent, ' without agent'), ''), iff(Silent > 0, strcat(' · ', Silent, ' silent'), ''), iff(NoData > 0, strcat(' · ', NoData, ' no data'), '')))
| extend Tiles = pack_array(
    pack('o', 0, 'l', '🖥️ Arc machines', 'v', InArcN, 'n', iff(InArcN == 0, 'none in scope', strcat(Connected, ' connected · ', InArcN - Connected, ' not connected'))),
    pack('o', 1, 'l', '📡 Reporting now', 'v', Reporting, 'n', ReportNote),
    pack('o', 2, 'l', '🪟 Windows', 'v', Windows, 'n', iff(Windows == 0, 'none in scope', iff(isempty(WinTiers), 'no tier tag', WinTiers))),
    pack('o', 3, 'l', '🐧 Linux', 'v', Linux, 'n', iff(Linux == 0, 'none in scope', iff(isempty(LinTiers), 'no tier tag', LinTiers))),
    pack('o', 4, 'l', '🗄️ SQL instances', 'v', SqlN, 'n', iff(SqlN == 0, 'no Arc SQL instance in scope', SqlNames)),
    pack('o', 5, 'l', '🏷️ Tagged (%)', 'v', iff(InArcN == 0, 0, tolong(round(100.0 * Tagged / InArcN, 0))), 'n', iff(InArcN == 0, 'none in scope', strcat(Tagged, ' of ', InArcN, ' have owner + cost centre'))),
    pack('o', 6, 'l', '🩹 Updates pending', 'v', Pending, 'n', case(InArcN == 0, 'none in scope', Pending == 0 and PatchGap == 0, 'all machines fully patched', strcat(PatchGap, ' failed or not assessed · ', Patched, ' patched'))),
    pack('o', 7, 'l', '🔔 Alerts fired', 'v', AlertN, 'n', iff(AlertN == 0, 'none in this window', strcat('highest ', AlertTop, ' · latest ', iff(AlertAgeMin < 120, strcat(AlertAgeMin, ' min ago'), iff(AlertAgeMin < 2880, strcat(tolong(round(AlertAgeMin / 60.0, 0)), ' h ago'), strcat(tolong(round(AlertAgeMin / 1440.0, 0)), ' d ago')))))))
| mv-expand Tiles
| project SortKey = tolong(Tiles.o), Label = tostring(Tiles.l), Value = tolong(Tiles.v), Note = tostring(Tiles.n)
| order by SortKey asc
| project Label, Value, Note

## Is the estate reporting, and how busy is it?
Hosts reporting counts distinct machines with a heartbeat in each interval; a parked period reads as zero hosts, which is expected and is not continuous uptime. The *Arc machines* line is the inventory: the gap to the reporting lines is machines with no monitoring agent.

content.json:
## Machines
One row per Arc machine: connection, telemetry, last heartbeat, load and update state. **Select a machine** to drive *Machine detail* below. A blank load figure is missing data, never zero.

content.query:
let OsF = dynamic([{OsFilter}]);
let EnvF = dynamic([{EnvironmentFilter}]);
let RoleF = dynamic([{RoleFilter}]);
let OsAll = array_length(OsF) == 0 or set_has_element(OsF, 'value::all') or set_has_element(OsF, '*');
let EnvAll = array_length(EnvF) == 0 or set_has_element(EnvF, 'value::all') or set_has_element(EnvF, '*');
let RoleAll = array_length(RoleF) == 0 or set_has_element(RoleF, 'value::all') or set_has_element(RoleF, '*');
let Start = todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}');
let End = todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}');
let Step = case(End - Start <= 6h, 5m, End - Start <= 2d, 15m, End - Start <= 8d, 1h, End - Start <= 16d, 2h, 6h);
let ArcInv = arg("").Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| project Machine = tolower(name), ArcName = name, ArcOs = iff(tostring(properties.osType) =~ 'windows', 'Windows', 'Linux'), ArcStatus = tostring(properties.status),
    Tier = tostring(tags.osTier), Role = tostring(tags.role), Env = tostring(tags.env), MonitorTier = tostring(tags.monitorTier), Owner = tostring(tags.owner), CostCentre = tostring(tags.costcenter);
let Beat = Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize LastBeat = max(TimeGenerated), BeatOs = take_any(OSType) by Machine = tolower(Computer);
let PatchRows = arg("").patchassessmentresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchassessmentresults'
| project Machine = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/')[8])), AssessmentStatus = tostring(properties.status), Critical = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.critical),
    Security = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.security), UpdateRollup = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.updateRollup),
    Definition = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.definition), LastAssessed = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime);
let AllMachines = union ArcInv, Beat, PatchRows
| summarize ArcName = take_any(ArcName), ArcOs = take_any(ArcOs), ArcStatus = take_any(ArcStatus), Tier = take_any(Tier), Role = take_any(Role), Env = take_any(Env),
    MonitorTier = take_any(MonitorTier), Owner = take_any(Owner), CostCentre = take_any(CostCentre), LastBeat = max(LastBeat), BeatOs = take_any(BeatOs),
    AssessmentStatus = take_any(AssessmentStatus), Critical = take_any(Critical), Security = take_any(Security), UpdateRollup = take_any(UpdateRollup),
    Definition = take_any(Definition), LastAssessed = max(LastAssessed) by Machine
| extend InArc = isnotempty(ArcStatus), Name = iff(isnotempty(ArcName), ArcName, Machine),
    Os = iff(isnotempty(ArcOs), ArcOs, iff(BeatOs =~ 'windows', 'Windows', 'Linux')),
    Env = iff(isempty(Env), '(untagged)', Env), Role = iff(isempty(Role), '(untagged)', Role)
| extend PatchState = case(
    not(InArc), 'Not applicable',
    isempty(AssessmentStatus), 'Not assessed',
    AssessmentStatus =~ 'Succeeded' and Critical > 0, 'Critical updates pending',
    AssessmentStatus =~ 'Succeeded' and Security > 0, 'Security updates pending',
    AssessmentStatus =~ 'Succeeded', 'Fully patched',
    AssessmentStatus =~ 'InProgress', 'Assessment in progress',
    'Assessment failed');
let Machines = AllMachines
| where (OsAll or Os in (OsF)) and (EnvAll or Env in (EnvF)) and (RoleAll or Role in (RoleF));
let MachineList = toscalar(Machines | summarize make_set(Machine));
let PerfRows = Perf
| where TimeGenerated between (Start .. End)
| extend Machine = tolower(Computer)
| where Machine in (MachineList)
| extend Metric = case(
    ObjectName in ("Processor Information", "Processor") and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName in ("_Total", "total"), "CPU percent",
    ObjectName == "Memory" and CounterName in ("% Committed Bytes In Use", "% Used Memory"), "Memory percent",
    ObjectName in ("LogicalDisk", "Logical Disk") and CounterName == "% Free Space", "Disk free percent", "")
| where Metric != ""
| extend IsAggregate = InstanceName in ("_Total", "total")
| where not(Metric == "Disk free percent" and not(IsAggregate) and (InstanceName startswith "/snap/" or InstanceName startswith "/run" or InstanceName startswith "/dev"
    or InstanceName startswith "/sys" or InstanceName startswith "/proc" or InstanceName startswith "/var/lib/snapd" or InstanceName startswith "/var/snap"))
| extend Instance = iff(Metric == "Disk free percent", iff(IsAggregate, "_Total (aggregate)", InstanceName), ""),
    Priority = case(ObjectName == "Processor Information", 0, Metric == "Disk free percent", iff(IsAggregate, 2, 0), 1),
    Value = todouble(CounterValue)
| project TimeGenerated, Machine, Metric, Instance, Priority, Value;
let InsightsRows = InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated between (Start .. End) and Origin == "vm.azm.ms" and Namespace == "LogicalDisk" and Name == "FreeSpacePercentage"
| extend Machine = tolower(Computer)
| where Machine in (MachineList)
| extend Metric = "Disk free percent", Instance = tostring(todynamic(Tags)["vm.azm.ms/mountId"]), Priority = 0, Value = todouble(Val)
| where isnotempty(Instance)
| project TimeGenerated, Machine, Metric, Instance, Priority, Value;
let AllSamples = materialize(union PerfRows, InsightsRows);
let Preferred = AllSamples | summarize Priority = min(Priority) by Machine, Metric;
let Samples = AllSamples
| join kind=inner Preferred on Machine, Metric, Priority
| where isnotnull(Value) and not(isnan(Value)) and not(isinf(Value)) and Value >= 0 and Value <= 100
| project TimeGenerated, Machine, Metric, Instance, Value;
let CpuStat = Samples | where Metric == "CPU percent" | summarize CpuMean = round(avg(Value), 1), CpuPeak = round(max(Value), 1) by Machine;
let MemStat = Samples | where Metric == "Memory percent" | summarize MemP95 = round(percentile(Value, 95), 1) by Machine;
let DiskLast = Samples | where Metric == "Disk free percent" | summarize MachineLast = max(TimeGenerated) by Machine;
let DiskStat = Samples
| where Metric == "Disk free percent"
| summarize LastSample = max(TimeGenerated), LowFree = min(Value) by Machine, Instance
| lookup (DiskLast) on Machine
| where LastSample >= MachineLast - 30m
| summarize FreePct = round(min(LowFree), 1) by Machine;
Machines
| lookup (CpuStat) on Machine
| lookup (MemStat) on Machine
| lookup (DiskStat) on Machine
| extend Age = iff(isnull(LastBeat), long(null), datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastBeat))
| extend Telemetry = case(isnotnull(Age) and Age <= 15, 'Reporting', isnotnull(Age), 'Silent', InArc and isempty(MonitorTier), 'No monitoring agent', 'No telemetry')
| extend LastHeartbeat = case(isnull(Age), 'none in 14 days', Age < 2, 'just now', Age < 120, strcat(Age, ' min ago'), Age < 2880, strcat(tolong(round(Age / 60.0, 0)), ' h ago'), strcat(tolong(round(Age / 1440.0, 0)), ' d ago'))
| extend Note = case(
    Telemetry == 'Reporting', '',
    Telemetry == 'Silent', 'Parked or agent stopped: last known values.',
    Telemetry == 'No monitoring agent', 'No Azure Monitor Agent: Arc inventory only.',
    'No heartbeat in 14 days: check the agent.')
| order by tolower(Name) asc
| project Machine = Name, Arc = iff(InArc, ArcStatus, 'Not in Arc'), Telemetry, LastHeartbeat, Os, Tier, Role, CpuMean, CpuPeak, MemP95, FreePct, Updates = PatchState, Note, DetailMode = iff(Telemetry == 'No monitoring agent', 'noagent', 'agent')

content.json:
### Memory in use, free disk and CPU peaks
Memory is Windows committed bytes in use or Linux used memory. Free disk is the tightest volume still reporting. Gaps are parked or silent periods: unknown, not idle. Linux memory and disk counters exist since they were added to the core data collection rule, so Linux history starts later.

content.json:
### Windows events and Linux syslog
Windows: critical, error and warning events (level-0 audit rows are excluded). Linux: syslog severities, where the agent reports *error* for errors; informational messages are left out of the chart. Both are ranked with the most severe first.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend Fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime)
| where Fired >= todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}') and Fired <= todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}')
| order by Fired desc
| take 15
| project Fired, Rule = extract('[^/]+$', 0, tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule)), Severity = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
    Condition = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition), State = tostring(properties.essentials.alertState), Target = tostring(properties.essentials.targetResourceName)

| project TimeGenerated, Machine, Metric, Instance, Priority, Value;
let AllSamples = materialize(union PerfRows, InsightsRows);
let Preferred = AllSamples | summarize Priority = min(Priority) by Machine, Metric;
let Samples = AllSamples
| join kind=inner Preferred on Machine, Metric, Priority
| where isnotnull(Value) and not(isnan(Value)) and not(isinf(Value)) and Value >= 0 and Value <= 100
| project TimeGenerated, Machine, Metric, Instance, Value;
let One = Machines | where Machine == tolower('{SelectedMachine}');
let CpuStat = Samples | where Metric == "CPU percent" | summarize CpuN = count(), CpuMean = round(avg(Value), 1), CpuPeak = round(max(Value), 1);
let MemStat = Samples | where Metric == "Memory percent" | summarize MemN = count(), MemP95 = round(percentile(Value, 95), 1);
let DiskStat = Samples | where Metric == "Disk free percent" | summarize LastSample = max(TimeGenerated), LowFree = min(Value) by Instance | where LastSample >= toscalar(Samples | where Metric == "Disk free percent" | summarize max(TimeGenerated)) - 30m | summarize FreePct = round(min(LowFree), 1);
One
| extend K = 1
| join kind=leftouter (CpuStat | extend K = 1) on K
| join kind=leftouter (MemStat | extend K = 1) on K
| join kind=leftouter (DiskStat | extend K = 1) on K
| extend Age = iff(isnull(LastBeat), long(null), datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastBeat))
| extend Tiles = pack_array(
    pack('o', 0, 'l', '🔗 Arc status', 'v', iff(InArc, ArcStatus, 'Not in Arc'), 'n', strcat(Os, ' · ', iff(isempty(Tier), 'no tier tag', Tier), ' · ', Role)),
    pack('o', 1, 'l', '📡 Last heartbeat', 'v', case(isnull(Age), 'none in 14 days', Age < 2, 'just now', Age < 120, strcat(Age, ' min ago'), Age < 2880, strcat(tolong(round(Age / 60.0, 0)), ' h ago'), strcat(tolong(round(Age / 1440.0, 0)), ' d ago')),
        'n', case(isnotnull(Age) and Age <= 15, 'reporting', isnotnull(Age), 'silent: parked or agent stopped', InArc and isempty(MonitorTier), 'no Azure Monitor Agent', 'no telemetry: check the agent')),
    pack('o', 2, 'l', '🩹 Updates', 'v', PatchState, 'n', iff(PatchState in ('Critical updates pending', 'Security updates pending', 'Fully patched'), strcat(coalesce(Critical, 0), ' critical · ', coalesce(Security, 0), ' security · ', coalesce(UpdateRollup, 0), ' rollup'), 'no usable assessment')),
    pack('o', 3, 'l', '⚙️ CPU avg / peak', 'v', iff(coalesce(CpuN, 0) == 0, 'no samples', strcat(CpuMean, ' / ', CpuPeak)), 'n', iff(coalesce(CpuN, 0) == 0, 'missing is not zero', '% over the time range')),
    pack('o', 4, 'l', '🧠 Memory P95', 'v', iff(coalesce(MemN, 0) == 0, 'no samples', tostring(MemP95)), 'n', iff(coalesce(MemN, 0) == 0, 'missing is not zero', '% in use over the time range')),
    pack('o', 5, 'l', '💽 Lowest free disk', 'v', iff(isnull(FreePct), 'no samples', tostring(FreePct)), 'n', iff(isnull(FreePct), 'missing is not zero', '% on the tightest volume')))
| mv-expand Tiles
| project SortKey = tolong(Tiles.o), Label = tostring(Tiles.l), Value = tostring(Tiles.v), Note = tostring(Tiles.n)
| order by SortKey asc
| project Label, Value, Note

content.json:
### How to read this page
- **Arc machines** are the Azure Arc inventory (Azure Resource Graph). **Reporting now** counts machines with a heartbeat in the last 15 minutes. A machine with no Azure Monitor Agent, such as the nested SQL guest, is in the inventory but sends no telemetry; it is counted once and never as extra capacity.
- **Last heartbeat** looks back 14 days regardless of the time range. A parked machine is *Silent*, not failed: its last observed values stay visible.
- **Load** is CPU, memory and free disk for the time range, from the same counters as the *Capacity and headroom* workbook. A blank is missing data, never zero. No thresholds are applied here: classification and sustained pressure are in *Capacity and headroom*.
- **Updates pending** is the latest Azure Update Manager assessment, so it reflects the last assessment time, not live state.
- **Alerts fired** counts alert instances that started in the time range for every alert rule in the subscription; it does not follow the machine filters.
- Filters: *All* means no filtering. Environment and Role come from each machine's current tags; an empty tag reads *(untagged)*.
- Nothing on this page starts, stops, changes or repairs anything.
